content.text: I fixed the home page. The hero illustration had about 100px of empty space under it, which pushed the stats row down and left a big gap in the hero. **Cause:** `site/assets/hero.svg` declared `viewBox="0 0 420 380"` with `height="380"`, but the artwork only fills 420×280. The stylesheet sets `height: auto`, so the browser rendered the image 380px tall. The extra 100px was transparent padding that made the hero too tall. **Fix:** I changed the SVG header to `viewBox="0 0 420 280" width="420" height="280"`. That matches the artwork and the `width`/`height` already on the `` in `index.html`. **Checks:** I screenshotted the page at desktop and mobile widths. After the fix the stats row sits against the hero as the CSS intends, and the gap is gone. I only re-screenshotted the desktop width after the fix, so the mobile layout is unchecked. All 16 functional tests pass. The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see what the last change was. I found this by inspecting the rendered page, so it may not be the exact change you had in mind. If something else still looks off, tell me what you're seeing. STATUS: DONE
